@deskTorAddressChangedTitle.description: Desktop Overview: title of the one-time notice a wallet from before this update sees: the app's Tor address (its onion) changed with the update. Tor stays 'Tor'.

deskTorAddressChangedText: The old address stops working. Anyone who saved it needs the new one.

@deskTorAddressChangedText.description: Desktop Overview: body of the one-time notice about the changed Tor address. Two short sentences.

@deskTorAddressChangedLink.description: Desktop Overview: button on the Tor address notice; opens a web page that says what changed and dismisses the notice.
